allow: PowerShell(foreach \($f in @\('data/d1.csv','data/idp.csv'\)\) { "--- $f ---"; Get-Content $f -TotalCount 2 }; "--- vip.csv \(LFS pointer\) ---"; Get-Content data/vip.csv -TotalCount 4)

PowerShell(git log --oneline -5; "---- vip.csv in first commit ----"; git cat-file -p "$\(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD\):data/vip.csv" | Select-Object -First 3; "---- largest blobs in main history ----"; git rev-list --objects main | git cat-file --batch-check='%\(objecttype\) %\(objectname\) %\(objectsize\) %\(rest\)' | Where-Object { $_ -match '^blob' } | ForEach-Object { $p=$_ -split ' '; [PSCustomObject]@{MB=[math]::Round\([int]$p[2]/1MB,2\); Path=$p[3]} } | Sort-Object MB -Descending | Select-Object -First 5 | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String)

PowerShell($env:GCM_INTERACTIVE='never'; $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0'; git status --short | Out-String; git push -u https://Nivakaran-S@github.com/Nivakaran-S/Cardioplace-BP-Alerts.git main 2>&1 | Out-String)

PowerShell(git remote set-url origin https://Nivakaran-S@github.com/Nivakaran-S/Cardioplace-BP-Alerts.git; $env:GCM_INTERACTIVE='never'; git fetch origin 2>&1 | Out-Null; git branch --set-upstream-to=origin/main main 2>&1 | Out-String; "---- final ----"; git branch -vv | Out-String; git status -sb | Out-String)
PowerShell($u = Get-Command uv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($u\) { "uv: $\($u.Source\)"; uv --version } else { "no uv" })
PowerShell($env:VIRTUAL_ENV = "$PWD\\.venv"; uv pip install -r requirements.txt 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 25)

PowerShell(if \(Test-Path .venv\\Lib\\site-packages\) { \(Get-ChildItem .venv\\Lib\\site-packages -Directory | Measure-Object\).Count } else { "no site-packages" }; "--- uv procs ---"; \(Get-Process uv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object\).Count)
PowerShell(\(Get-ChildItem .venv\\Lib\\site-packages -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object\).Count; \(Get-Process uv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object\).Count)

PowerShell($c = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\uv\\cache"; if \(Test-Path $c\) { $s = \(Get-ChildItem $c -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum\); "cache files: $\($s.Count\) | MB: $\([math]::Round\($s.Sum/1MB,1\)\)" } else { "no uv cache at $c" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://pypi.org/simple/numpy/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; "pypi reachable: HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\), $\([math]::Round\($r.RawContentLength/1KB,1\)\) KB" } catch { "pypi unreachable: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($py = \(Get-Command python\).Source; "python: $py"; & $py -c "import sys; print\(sys.prefix\)"; foreach \($m in 'numpy','pandas','sklearn','scipy','yaml','joblib','pyarrow','dotenv','mlflow','dagshub'\) { $r = & $py -c "import $m, sys; print\('$m', getattr\($m,'__version__','?'\)\)" 2>$null; if \($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0\) { $r } else { "$m MISSING" } })

PowerShell(Get-Process uv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "uv stopped"; $py = "C:\\Users\\LENOVO\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\Python\\Python313\\python.exe"; & $py -c "import sklearn, mlflow, dagshub; print\('imports fine'\)")
PowerShell(Get-Process python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, CPU, @{n='WS_MB';e={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet64/1MB\)}}, StartTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String)
